Name: More Lively Eyes
Author: kioffeeuu
Description:
[font=Lucida Sans Unicode][size=3]My lazy ass finally decided to update this little mod to the latest version. Sorry for the wait (if anyone ever wanted it)!

[b]★ How the mod works?
[/b]It will simply add a shade to the eyes of your farmer to make them look less dead. But, [b]it will only modify the vanilla body[/b]! If you want me to make it compatible with mods that modify the farmer's body, please let me know, thank you!

[b]★ How to install? ★[/b]
☆ Simply download the .rar and extract it into your mods folder.
That's it! Please enjoy and have a lovely game! <3

[b]★ Compatible with?[/b]
☆ [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7331]More Elegant Farmer body[/url] [i](I want to clarify that this mod already does what my mod does, so there's no need to have my mod installed too. They won't collide if you want to have both, but it'll be meaningless.)[/i]
